name: Buddy World Lens
purpose: Turn owner-approved device GPS into a local-first spatial workspace for personal waypoints and Buddy task packets.

inspiration.project: God's Eye View by Bilawal Sidhu
inspiration.adaptation: Independent DreamCo implementation using its own interface, language, code, and local-first GPS scope. No upstream code or media is included.

privacy.browser_storage: Waypoints remain in this browser until the owner clears them.
privacy.network_default: External maps and property searches remain off until the owner enables them and accepts the provider disclosure.
privacy.background_tracking: page_open_only; native-app background service required for closed-app tracking

connections.external_map: owner_enabled OpenStreetMap embed; sends the viewed coordinates to OpenStreetMap
connections.property_provider: owner-configured HTTPS endpoint returning authorized listing JSON; RESO-shaped fields and source-attributed history are supported
connections.geocoder: owner-configured HTTPS backend for resolving voice-requested place names without exposing provider secrets
connections.automatic_property_scan: runs only while live GPS and the property connection toggle are both enabled

voice_commands: mark here as NAME note NOTE
mark LATITUDE LONGITUDE as NAME note NOTE
mark PLACE as NAME note NOTE
